## 🎯 Table Selection Matrix

| Analysis Type | Primary Tables | Key Points |
|---------------|----------------|------------|
| **Pipeline Management** | `opportunity`, `opportunity_history` | Deal progression and stage analysis |
| **Revenue Analytics** | `opportunity`, `opportunity_product` | Financial performance and product mix |
| **Account Management** | `account`, `contact`, `account_team_member` | Customer relationships and coverage |
| **Sales Performance** | `user`, `territory`, `opportunity` | Rep performance and territory management |
| **Partner Channel** | `opportunity_partner`, `account` | Channel partner performance and attribution |
| **Product Analysis** | `product`, `opportunity_product`, `orders` | Product performance and bundling |
